
# Project Title

*Real TIME Forum*

Welcome to the Web Forum Project! This project aims to create a web forum where users can communicate, interact with posts and comments, and filter content. Below you'll find all the necessary information to understand, set up, and contribute to this project.
Objectives


## Installation



To get started with this project, follow these steps:
* Prerequisites

    Install Go (Go programming language).
    Install Docker for containerization.

* Installation

    Clone the project repository:
    
    >git clone https://learn.zone01dakar.sn/git/alogou/real-time-forum
    


* Build and run the Docker container:

    -bash

    >docker build -t REALTIMEFORUM .

    >docker run -p 8081:8081 REALTIMEFORUM

    -use the script to run the Docker container

    >chmod +x docker_run.sh

     >./docker_run.sh

    Access the forum in your web browser at http://localhost:8081.
    

    ## Objectives
    On this project you will have to focus on a few points:

    Registration and Login
    Creation of posts
    Commenting posts
    Private Messages
